name: Oryx Bookings
author: Rabie Eltegani

sections.description:
Oryx Bookings lets you accept and manage appointments directly from your WordPress site. Set up your services and staff, configure your working hours, and let your customers book online — all without leaving WordPress.

Whether you run a salon, clinic, consulting firm, spa, or any service-based business, Oryx Bookings gives you everything you need in one plugin.

Key Highlights

  • Unlimited Services & Staff — Create as many services and team members as you need
  • Interactive Calendar — Visual calendar view to manage all your bookings at a glance
  • 6 Booking Form Templates — Grid, Stepper, Accordion, Card Flow, Flat Split, and Focus Input
  • Works Everywhere — Elementor widget, Gutenberg block, or simple shortcode
  • Smart Scheduling — Real-time availability with automatic double-booking prevention
  • Secure & GDPR-Ready — Built-in spam protection, rate limiting, reCAPTCHA v3, and WordPress privacy tools integration

Services

  • Custom name, duration, price, description, and featured image per service
  • Rich content editor with media support
  • Organize services into categories
  • Two scheduling modes: Staff-based or Service-only (uses company hours directly)

Staff

  • Staff profiles with name, job title, and photo
  • Flexible availability: follow company hours or set a custom weekly schedule
  • Individual days off per staff member
  • Assign multiple staff to each service

Bookings

  • Real-time available time slots based on service duration
  • Booking statuses: Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed
  • Collects customer name, email, and optionally phone, address, and notes
  • Configurable form fields — enable or disable optional fields from Settings

Calendar

  • Full interactive calendar (day, week, month, and list views)
  • Create, edit, drag-and-drop, and delete bookings directly from the calendar
  • Filter by staff or service
  • Visual color coding by booking status
  • Validates working hours, days off, and overlapping bookings in real time

Working Hours & Holidays

  • Set opening and closing times for each day of the week
  • Mark specific days as closed
  • Add company holidays — bookings are automatically blocked on those dates

6 Beautiful Templates

All three display methods (Elementor, Gutenberg, Shortcode) share the same set of templates:

  1. Grid — Classic card layout
  2. Stepper — Step-by-step guided flow
  3. Accordion — Collapsible sections
  4. Card Flow — Modern card-based progression
  5. Flat Split — Clean split layout
  6. Focus Input — Minimal, focused design

Each template is fully responsive and AJAX-powered for a smooth, no-reload experience.

Elementor Widget

  • Drag-and-drop from the “Oryx Bookings” widget category
  • Live preview in the Elementor editor
  • Controls for template, colors, labels, display toggles, typography, and more

Gutenberg Block

  • Search “Oryx – Booking Form” in the block inserter
  • Server-side preview directly in the editor
  • Sidebar controls for all settings

Shortcode

Use [oryx_bookings] on any page with any theme or page builder. Customize per instance:

[oryx_bookings template="stepper" primary_color="#EF4444" show_price="no"]

A built-in Shortcode Generator is available at Oryx Bookings > Settings > Design.

Use [oryx_bookings_my_bookings] to let logged-in customers view their booking history.

Customization

  • Primary Color — Match your brand with a single color setting
  • Display Toggles — Show or hide service image, description, price, duration, and staff image
  • Custom Labels — Change step titles, button text, and the success message
  • Currency — Set symbol and position (before or after)
  • Time Format — 12-hour or 24-hour
  • Redirect URL — Send customers to a thank-you page after booking

Security

  • Rate limiting per IP for slot lookups and booking creation
  • Honeypot fields and time-based tokens to block bots
  • Signed slot tokens with expiration
  • Booking lock system to prevent race conditions
  • Google reCAPTCHA v3 support
  • Booking limits per email, IP, and phone number
  • Email and IP blocklist
  • Security event logging

GDPR Compliance

  • Integrated with WordPress personal data export and erasure tools
  • Customer records are anonymized (not deleted) to preserve business data

Translation-Ready

  • Fully translatable — all strings use the oryx-bookings text domain
  • RTL-compatible design

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries:

Flatpickr

  • Version: 4.6.13
  • Description: Lightweight datetime picker
  • Website: https://flatpickr.js.org/
  • License: MIT
  • Copyright: Gregory Petrosyan

FullCalendar

  • Version: 6.1.10
  • Description: Full-featured calendar component
  • Website: https://fullcalendar.io/
  • License: MIT
  • Copyright: Adam Shaw
sections.installation:
1. Upload the oryx-bookings folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen
  3. Go to Oryx Bookings > Settings > Working Hours and set your business hours
  4. Add your team under Oryx Bookings > Staff
  5. Create your services under Oryx Bookings > Services and assign staff
  6. Add the booking form to any page using the Elementor widget, Gutenberg block, or [oryx_bookings] shortcode
sections.faq:
How do I add a booking form to my site?

You have three options:

  • Elementor — Drag the “Booking Form” widget from the Oryx Bookings category
  • Gutenberg — Add the “Oryx – Booking Form” block
  • Shortcode — Paste [oryx_bookings] into any page or post

Can I use this without staff members?

Yes. Set the service’s Availability Mode to “Service-only” and it will use your company working hours directly — no staff selection step.

How does the plugin prevent double-bookings?

Multiple layers: real-time availability checks, overlap detection, a temporary booking lock during processing, and a final server-side check before saving.

Can I customize the look of the booking form?

Yes. Choose from 6 templates, set a primary color, toggle what information is shown, and customize all labels. You can do this globally in Settings > Design, per shortcode via attributes, or through the Elementor/Gutenberg controls.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. Oryx Bookings integrates with WordPress privacy tools. Customer data can be exported or anonymized through the standard WordPress privacy request workflow.

Does it work with Elementor and Gutenberg?

Yes — native integrations for both, with live preview and full control over settings.

Can staff have their own schedules?

Yes. Each staff member can follow the company default hours or have a fully custom weekly schedule, plus individual days off.

Can customers view their bookings?

Yes. Add [oryx_bookings_my_bookings] to any page to let logged-in users see their booking history.

What happens on company holidays?

When you add a date under Settings > Holidays, the booking form automatically blocks that date — no time slots will be shown.

Can I redirect customers after booking?

Yes. Set a redirect URL in the Design settings, shortcode attributes, or Elementor/Gutenberg controls. Customers will be redirected to that page after a successful booking.
